Heritage Design System

Inspired by 13th-century Augustinian architecture, local Charnwood Forest flora, and medieval manuscript parchment. Every component is engineered for zero-code trustee content management, tactile elegance, and verified WCAG 2.2 AA high legibility.

Color Architecture

Historic Heritage Palette

A grounded palette echoing Charnwood stone, ivy-clad medieval arches, and illuminated monastic accounts.

Primary Ivy Green#2F4A3A

Primary buttons, site hero identity, navigation accents, active borders.

Background Parchment#F6F1E7

Warm, restful page backdrop providing high contrast without clinical harshness.

Card Surface#FFFFFF

Crisp interior surface for elevated cards, modals, and content containers.

Weathered Stone#D9D4C7

Subtle structural borders, table dividers, card outlines, and badges.

Deep Ink Text#1E211E

High-contrast organic body and headline ink avoiding artificial pure black.

Heritage Burgundy#7A2E3A

Interactive states, text links, urgent notices, and outline action buttons.

Divider Candle Gold#B8923A

Ornamental dividers, focal accents, focus rings, and milestone badges.

Typography Hierarchy

Editorial Legibility

Combining the classical elegance of Cormorant Garamond with the clean, modern clarity of Source Sans 3 at minimum 18px base text.

Display H1 · Cormorant Garamond 56px
The Augustinian Canonesses of Grace Dieu
Heading H2 · Cormorant Garamond 40px
Conservation of an 800-Year-Old Charnwood Landmark
Heading H3 · Cormorant Garamond 28px
Dame Petronella’s Household Accounts & Monastic Life
Body Text · Source Sans 3 (18px Base / 1.65 Line Height)

Grace Dieu Priory was founded around 1239 by Roesia de Verdun, an independent noblewoman praised by King Henry III. Following the 1538 Dissolution, the priory was transformed into a Tudor estate and later became the birthplace of dramatist Francis Beaumont. Today, the conserved masonry remains accessible free of charge to the public through the voluntary devotion of the Friends of Grace Dieu Priory.

Strict Policy: Paranormal Events Prohibited

The Friends of Grace Dieu Priory no longer hold paranormal events or ghost walks. 3rd-party commercial paranormal investigations are expressly forbidden across the entire site by the Grace Dieu Priory Trust.
